outcome: total analgesic medication consumed during the first 24 hours post-op
duration of motor and sensory blocks
hemodynamic changes (pulse rate, mean arterial pressure)
cohort: 80 parturients undergoing elective caesarean sections at the Gayatri Vidya Parishad Institute of Health Care and Medical Technology, Andhra Pradesh, India
finding: 5 mcg of dexmedetomidine added to 10 mg of 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine provided the optimal duration of analgesia and patient/surgeon satisfaction for spinal anesthesia in caesarean sections.
